about_the_game:
Play as Rose and Violet in an exciting twin-stick shooter! Match your shots to enemy colors and test your skills in this intense single-player challenge. Outsmart foes, take down mighty bosses, and reclaim your lost kingdom in a flower-themed adventure with global leaderboards!

Game features:

  • Control both Rose and Violet with a single controller, coordinating your shots using the analog sticks!

  • Join the bravest knights in the flower kingdom on their quest to reclaim liberty!

  • Fight an army of robots, each with their own behavior and moveset!

  • Climb your way up to the top in the global leaderboards, clearing all levels in the shortest time possible!

  • Explore a variety of hand-drawn environments, helping Rose and Violet through their marvelous journey across the flower world.

short_description: Join Rose and Violet in an epic single-player twin-stick shooter! Use both the analogue sticks with their color-coded shots to defeat matching foes as you battle through lots of hardcore levels. Outsmart enemies, conquer powerful bosses, and restore your flower kingdom in this vibrant adventure!
